decisions.reason: The font and two-straight-line arrangement apply specifically to the bottle-and-cloud design; the stamped-meat design retains its independent stamped slogan treatment.
The source changes typography for the bottle-and-cloud design only and does not alter the grill design's smoke-rendered slogan or readability requirement.
The shared typography component is incidental; the source refers to a different design and does not change the Riverton sky text, text bubble, or span.
Selecting a font and changing the text arrangement do not alter the requirement that all illustrations be hand-drawn and non-AI.
